authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full chādi explicitly gives Bshk čī ashes, regional chāī and Assamese sāi. These support Bshk cē and both cī/ce alternatives, plus provisionally Goj sayī with a sibilant realization. Preserve source vowels; local sound history and cross-IA transmission remain qualified. The separate kṣāma addendum gives nasal Assamese chā̃i, which does not require moving these nonnasal responses to that family. Exact response: sayī.
